question: The Koyna Project is constructed on a tributary of the River Krishna in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Koyna Project is constructed on the **Koyna River**, which is a major tributary of the Krishna River.
 
• The project is located in the **state of Maharashtra**, India.
 
• The Koyna Dam, a part of this project, is one of the largest dams in Maharashtra and plays a significant role in hydroelectric power generation.
 
• The hydroelectric project has a total installed capacity of **1,960 MW**, making it a crucial source of renewable energy in the state.
 
• The Koyna River originates in the **Western Ghats** near Mahabaleshwar in Maharashtra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Koyna River:**

 
 
• The Koyna River is a key tributary of the Krishna River, which is one of the largest rivers in peninsular India.
 
• It originates in the Western Ghats and flows through Maharashtra before joining the Krishna River.
 
 
 
• **Koyna Dam:**
 
 
• The Koyna Dam is a rubble-concrete dam constructed on the Koyna River in Satara district, Maharashtra.
 
• It was constructed in 1964 and is designed primarily for hydroelectric power generation and irrigation.
 
• The dam has been instrumental in mitigating floods and supporting agriculture in the region.
 
 
 
• **Krishna River:**
 
 
• The Krishna River is the fourth-largest river in India, flowing through Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is a lifeline for agriculture and drinking water supply in these states.
 
 
 
• **Western Ghats:**
 
 
• The Western Ghats, a UNESCO World Heritage site, are a mountain range that runs parallel to the western coast of India.
 
• The range is known for its rich biodiversity and is the origin of many rivers, including the Koyna.
